Logic Analysis: CMakeLists.txt

dependency/build; declares reusable core library from src/*.cpp (excluding src/Main.cpp), builds runtime demo executable from src/Main.cpp linked to core, builds single test executable from tests/test_main.cpp linked to core; calls enable_testing() and registers add_test()
src/Main.cpp
runtime/bootstrap; thin deterministic demo wiring that constructs GameEngine, applies a fixed sequence of moves (Alice=X first, Eve=O next), prints a concise summary, and exits; no interactive I/O
tests/test_main.cpp
automated-test; headless test exercising GameEngine via headers only; validates basic wiring plus one core rule (e.g., win detection or alternation); no GUI, network, or filesystem
include/Common.h
interface; declares core enums/types used across modules: Player, CellState, GameStatus, MoveError; no implementation
include/Board.h
interface; declares Board grid entity: dimensions, storage for cells, safe get/set, bounds checks, fullness, clear
include/Move.h
interface; declares Move value type (row, col, player) with equality operators; may include lightweight validation helpers
include/MoveHistory.h
interface; declares MoveHistory for auditing: push, undo, list, clear, size
include/WinDetector.h
interface; declares WinDetector pure rules: scan horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals for five-in-a-row; helper to scan from a start in a direction
include/GameEngine.h
interface; declares GameEngine orchestrator: apply validated moves, enforce alternation, update status (win/draw), expose board and history, reset
src/Board.cpp
domain-entity implementation; implements Board storage, bounds-safe get/set, fullness and clear
src/Move.cpp
domain-entity implementation; implements Move operators and any lightweight helpers
src/MoveHistory.cpp
domain-entity implementation; maintains sequence of moves, supports undo and clear
src/WinDetector.cpp
pure-rule implementation; scans Board for five aligned cells belonging to a player; no side effects
src/GameEngine.cpp
orchestration implementation; coordinates Board, WinDetector, and MoveHistory; applies moves for current player, enforces alternation and game-over rules, updates GameStatus, supports reset
Test Scope Plan: basic runtime wiring via GameEngine API: construct engine, ensure initial status InProgress and current player is Player::X (Alice)
core rule: win detection for five-in-a-row (horizontal or vertical) using alternating valid moves; assert status transitions to WonX or WonO appropriately

C++ Build Link Audit.notes: Core library should compile from src/Board.cpp, src/Move.cpp, src/MoveHistory.cpp, src/WinDetector.cpp, src/GameEngine.cpp. src/Main.cpp must not be part of the core library. tests/test_main.cpp must not include or compile any src/*.cpp directly.

Full API spec:
include/Common.h: enum class Player { X, O }; enum class CellState { Empty, X, O }; enum class GameStatus { InProgress, WonX, WonO, Draw }; enum class MoveError { None, OutOfBounds, Occupied, NotYourTurn, GameOver }.
include/Board.h: class Board { public: explicit Board(size_t w = 15, size_t h = 15); size_t getWidth() const noexcept; size_t getHeight() const noexcept; bool inBounds(size_t r, size_t c) const noexcept; CellState get(size_t r, size_t c) const; // Pre: inBounds(r,c); returns CellState::Empty/X/O. bool set(size_t r, size_t c, CellState s); // Sets cell if in-bounds and returns true; returns false if out-of-bounds. bool isFull() const noexcept; void clear(); }.
include/Move.h: struct Move { size_t row; size_t col; Player player; Move(size_t r, size_t c, Player p); bool operator==(const Move& other) const noexcept; }.
include/MoveHistory.h: class MoveHistory { public: void push(const Move& m); bool undo(Move& out); // Pops last move into out; returns false if empty. const std::vector<Move>& all() const noexcept; void clear() noexcept; size_t size() const noexcept; }.
include/WinDetector.h: class WinDetector { public: static std::optional<Player> checkWin(const Board& b); // Returns Player when a five-in-a-row is present, otherwise std::nullopt. static bool hasFiveFrom(const Board& b, size_t r, size_t c, int dr, int dc); // Helper: scans contiguous cells starting at (r,c) inclusive in direction (dr,dc). }.
include/GameEngine.h: class GameEngine { public: explicit GameEngine(size_t w = 15, size_t h = 15); const Board& getBoard() const noexcept; Player getCurrentPlayer() const noexcept; GameStatus getStatus() const noexcept; const MoveHistory& getHistory() const noexcept; MoveError applyMove(size_t r, size_t c); // Applies a move for current player at (r,c). Returns OutOfBounds if invalid coordinates; Occupied if cell not empty; NotYourTurn only if an external caller attempts to bypass alternation (tests will call only via this method which handles alternation); GameOver if status is not InProgress; None on success. void reset(); }.
Semantics: - Game starts with current player Player::X (Alice). After a successful move, alternates to Player::O (Eve). - Board cells reflect CellState::X or CellState::O based on moves. - After every successful move, WinDetector::checkWin is invoked; status becomes WonX or WonO if a five-in-a-row is found; on a full board without winner, status becomes Draw; otherwise InProgress. - MoveHistory records every successful move in order; reset() clears board, history, status, and sets current to Player::X. - No I/O, timing, or environment dependencies exist in core modules. - Include direction rules: src/*.cpp include their corresponding include/*.h and other headers as needed; tests/test_main.cpp includes declared headers only and never src/*.cpp.
Shared Knowledge: Project builds a reusable core library from src/Board.cpp, src/Move.cpp, src/MoveHistory.cpp, src/WinDetector.cpp, src/GameEngine.cpp. Runtime entry is src/Main.cpp and is linked against the core library. tests/test_main.cpp is the only protocol test file; it includes include/GameEngine.h (and optionally include/Common.h, include/Board.h) only and links to the core library. No GUI or network is present; tests are headless-friendly and operate purely in-memory.
Execution Protocol: Run ctest. The CMake project defines: a core library built from non-Main sources, a demo executable from src/Main.cpp linked to the core library, and a test executable from tests/test_main.cpp linked to the core library. enable_testing() and add_test() register the single protocol test. Runtime entry: src/Main.cpp. The test is non-interactive and includes declared headers only.
Anything UNCLEAR: Default board size is assumed to be 15x15; overline or renju restrictions are not applied (simple five-in-a-row wins). If a different size or variant rules are desired, please specify.
